entities.summary: The Port of Mongla is a Bangladeshi seaport, located at Mongla upazila, Bagerhat district, Khulna division. It is located near the north shore of the Bay of Bengal. It is the second largest and busiest seaport of Bangladesh after the Port of Chittagong. The Mongla port lies close to the shore of the Bay of Bengal, Pashur river and the divisional city of Khulna. It is also connected by rail with Khulna. Additionally, an airport had been planned and authorized near the post area named Khan Jahan Ali Airport; however the construction has stalled in the last few years.
